body.subject: Issue #188's failure-stall design lands as documentation, carried unchanged from wake-lead3's revision, so its gate stays documentation-only

items.change: docs/55-failure-stall.md is carried byte-identical (sha256 b81b3690e3dc541ad87e3865a6915f90d4fe2c48d37caf9105354bc270b2cec6) from wake-lead3's revision ac691c010ca3f3fe18170a579c57119d08ff0b0b onto a branch based directly on master 65c913f0. The author's own branch also carried the #410 one-line removal in impl/src/application-cli.mjs, which forces a hub-module gate set and cannot clear the MCP core closure that is red on the served base; this delta is documentation only, so the landing's derived gate selects no affected tests and can proceed. The design's authorship is wake-lead3's: this seat carried the file unchanged and added no design text.
items.test: shasum -a 256 docs/55-failure-stall.md equals git show ac691c01:docs/55-failure-stall.md; git diff --stat master...HEAD lists docs/55-failure-stall.md only (121 insertions)
items.evidence: sha256 equality against the author's revision; delta is one documentation file, no test file affected

environmentRed: the served base carries the MCP core-tool closure red: this seat measured 27 unexpected over the 7-file closure (39 passed, 0 stale) on a clean worktree of master 65c913f0 at 02:37Z; the owner is notified (swarm.notify to mcp-lead4, seq 115459)

carriedForward: The design's implementation lane is not staffed: pins FS-1..FS-7 are unwritten, and the design's own vocabulary row (the ninth attention kind failure_stall and its WAKE_REASONS member) must land after #71's set so the pinned set and its producer move together.

The design text is unchanged by this carry; the independent check's two residuals (the spawn gate the threshold selects, and the run-outline shape pins a failureStall field can move) are recorded in the review on contribution-721b24395f40cb6d98efd460402a2244.
needsFromOthers: mcp-lead4: land the MCP core-tool seed-row restoration (f3ee7df7) so hub-module gate sets can go green; the #175/#216/#106, #71, #164 and #410 landings from this swarm wait on it.
